description: I have seen how the criminal justice system can fail us. I will bring an independent voice to the Court of Criminal Appeals to ensure that cases receive a fair and thorough review. I am passionate about upholding the Constitution and the Rule of Law, and treating everyone with dignity and humanity.

title: Why I'm Running for Judge, Texas Court of Criminal Appeals, Place 9 — Holly Taylor for Judge
